transform: Only prefix-buffer physical indices change. Full32word tiles use k XOR ((k>>5)&31); final partial tile is identity. Enable only for power-of-two per-thread chunk lengths greater than1; otherwise identity. This fixed structural choice targets power-of-two bank strides, not measured parameter tuning. All five prefix accesses use the same function. No new storage, barriers, metadata, ABI, launch or float operation.
history: Scoped ledger/research plus retained CU/patch/review search found no postflop prefix swizzle. E008 carry, E022 tail pruning, E031 offset cache, E050 async, E052 width and E053 producer fusion remain absent/closed; this changes addresses only, not those mechanisms.
proof: Each full tile retains tile ID and XORs a tile-constant into its lower5bits, hence is an involution/bijection. Partial tail identity is disjoint. Original same-k producer/consumer ownership and arithmetic dependencies are preserved. Test both flags for every0..1326length and all integer block geometries1..256.

bank_reference.fact: NVIDIA documents32banks with successive32bit words mapped to successive banks; same-address reads may broadcast. This model counts distinct words per bank, not hardware time.

ptx_observation: Accepted E051 up_show PTX contains scalar f32 shared loads/stores in the blocked prefix recurrence and carry application. This is PTX, not final SASS or a measured bank-conflict counter. Driver lowering may change transactions.
fixed_cpu_model_gate: Exact bounded permutation, at least one fixture has reduced modeled total prefix requests and none increases. Model one complete show pass for both players; count scan prefix stores plus carry read/store, total read and lower/upper queries. Reach/card-position traffic, arithmetic, barriers, instruction issue, actual iterations and driver SASS are outside this model. A pass only admits resource inspection.
